name: megane3-eps-reset
label: Megane III / Scenic III / Zoe / Fluence EPS reset
description: Reads the dongle state, then blanks it so the steering column can be paired to another vehicle.
warning: Blanks the steering column's dongle pairing, which unpairs it from the vehicle.
_unverified: Not run against a vehicle. Slug and request names are checked against the database; the effect is not.
